text:
danielle: FYI from this morning's Cobalt sync — theywant SSO + searchable audit logs in the MVP and asked to pull the pilot forward by 10 days.

ryan: 10 days earlier? which date exactly?

danielle: They want pilot week of 2025-10-06 (we're currently on 2025-10-16). LOI is verbal for now.

ishaan: SSO core (OIDC passthrough) is fine for MVP. Searchable audit logs (indexed + export) touches infra + legal. Two quick paths:

ishaan: A) MVP-base: auth + SSO passthrough, events streamed to customer sink. keeps schedule.

ishaan: B) MVP-indexed: auth + SSO + 30d indexed audit + export API -> adds ~10d, infra delta, compliance signoff.

megan: Compliance flag: indexing triggers retention policy and cross-border review for Cobalt's EU customers. Need legal in the loop before we promise.

ryan: Can we offer a conditional commit to B ("we'll deliver B if LOI confirmed by X date") and otherwise ship A? Sales prefers that.

ishaan: Tech sketch for B:
```
MVP-indexed-impact:
  infra: +1 index shard (search), +1 retention-store
  estimated-cost: ~$7.5k/mo
  eng: ~+10d (0.8 FTE)
  blockers: legal/compliance signoff for EU retention
```

deploy-bot: Heads-up: auth-service canary 2025-10-03 02:00 UTC — coordinate feature flags if we pick the indexed cut.

megan: If we do timeline reset, recommend we trade non-customer-facing items (UX polish, internal metrics) to buy days. Also push advanced telemetry to v1.

danielle: Sales note: Cobalt will sign LOI if we commit to indexed audit in MVP but they asked for a firm cost/retention plan in writing.

ryan: Action items: @ishaan to post A/B cutlist with time/cost/risk + a one-paragraph customer-facing blurb for sales by EOD. @danielle to confirm LOI deadline. Reconvene tomorrow 09:30 PT to decide.

ishaan: I'll include a quick negotiation line: "we can include indexed audit in MVP conditioned on LOI by 2025-09-25 and 3 months infra commitment".

megan: Also add: region-specific retention constraints (EU) require written confirmation of customer data residency preferences.

danielle: Sounds good. meeting tomorrow 09:30. :thumbsup:
